ex.en: Under the teacher's guidance, I took big strides with my studies.
ex.zh: 在老師的指導下，我的課業進步很多。

ex.en: This type of exercise can be practiced alone and does not require a coach's guidance.
ex.zh: 這類運動可以獨自練習，不需要教練指導。

ex.en: Thank you for your guidance on this project.
ex.zh: 謝謝你在這個專案上的指導。

guidance.en: help and advice about how to do something

ex.en: There was some chewing gum on the sole of Tom's shoe.
ex.zh: 湯姆的鞋底黏到了口香糖。

ex.en: Chewing gum is not allowed in class.
ex.zh: 上課時不准嚼口香糖。

gum.en: a sweet substance that you chew but do not swallow

ex.en: Do your gums bleed?
ex.zh: 你的牙齦會流血嗎？

ex.en: My gums are bleeding.
ex.zh: 我的牙齦在流血。

ex.en: Can you have a look at my gums?
ex.zh: 可以幫我看一下牙齦嗎？

gum.en: the pink flesh in your mouth around your teeth

ex.en: Our troops were constantly attacked by the guerrillas.
ex.zh: 我們的部隊不斷遭到游擊隊攻擊。

ex.en: The guerrillas hid in the mountains.
ex.zh: 游擊隊躲在山裡。

guerrilla.en: a member of a small group that fights against a larger army

ex.en: The startup used guerrilla marketing to attract attention.
ex.zh: 這家新創公司用游擊式行銷吸引注意。

ex.en: Guerrilla marketing works well on a small budget.
ex.zh: 預算少的時候，游擊式行銷很有效。

guerrilla.en: a cheap and creative way of advertising that surprises people

ex.en: The guy swimming in the river is my friend.
ex.zh: 在河裡游泳的那個人是我朋友。

ex.en: Do you think of me as a cool guy?
ex.zh: 你覺得我是個很酷的人嗎？

ex.en: He won't be easily discouraged, because he's a tough guy.
ex.zh: 他是個硬漢，不會輕易灰心。

ex.en: He is my friend. Do you guys know him?
ex.zh: 他是我的朋友，你們認識他嗎？

ex.en: I want you guys to do me a favor.
ex.zh: 我想請你們幫我個忙。

guy.en: used to talk to a group of people

ex.en: You very nearly guessed it.
ex.zh: 你差一點就猜對了。

ex.en: Tomiko guessed my weight correctly.
ex.zh: 富子猜中了我的體重。

ex.en: Can you guess how old she is?
ex.zh: 你猜得出她幾歲嗎？

guess.en: to give an answer without knowing if it is right

ex.en: I guess you heard about what happened this morning.
ex.zh: 我想你應該聽說今天早上發生的事了。

ex.en: I guess I'll take the bus today.
ex.zh: 我想我今天搭公車好了。

guess.en: to say what you think is probably true

ex.en: My guess is that it will be fine tomorrow.
ex.zh: 我猜明天會是好天氣。

ex.en: Take a guess!
ex.zh: 猜猜看！

guess.en: an answer or opinion that you give without being sure

ex.en: They heard a gun go off in the distance.
ex.zh: 他們聽到遠處傳來槍聲。

ex.en: Tom said he keeps a gun in his home.
ex.zh: 湯姆說他家裡有一把槍。

ex.en: The policeman aimed his gun at the man.
ex.zh: 警察把槍瞄準那個男人。

gun.en: a weapon that shoots small metal objects

ex.en: I guarantee that this information is correct.
ex.zh: 我保證這些資訊是正確的。

ex.en: I can't guarantee that that's going to happen.
ex.zh: 我不能保證那一定會發生。

ex.en: They guarantee this clock can be used for a year.
ex.zh: 他們保證這個時鐘可以用一年。

guarantee.en: to promise that something will happen or is true

ex.en: The TV comes with a two-year guarantee.
ex.zh: 這台電視有兩年保固。

ex.en: There's no guarantee that the plan will work.
ex.zh: 不能保證這個計畫一定會成功。

guarantee.en: a written promise that a company will fix a product if it breaks

ex.en: The security guard checked my ID.
ex.zh: 警衛檢查了我的證件。

ex.en: There are two guards at the gate.
ex.zh: 大門口有兩名警衛。

guard.en: a person whose job is to protect a place or person

ex.en: The soldiers were guarding the bridge.
ex.zh: 士兵們守衛著這座橋。

ex.en: The palace was heavily guarded.
ex.zh: 皇宮戒備森嚴。

guard.en: to protect a place or person from danger or attack

ex.en: Be on your guard. He's not an easy one to fool.
ex.zh: 要提防，他不是那麼容易被騙的。

ex.en: Be on your guard against online scams.
ex.zh: 要提防網路詐騙。

guard.en: being careful because something bad might happen

ex.en: She declared that she was not guilty.
ex.zh: 她聲稱自己無罪。

ex.en: Nobody can deny that the prisoner is guilty.
ex.zh: 沒有人能否認那名犯人有罪。

guilty.en: having done something that is against the law

ex.en: I feel guilty about missing her birthday.
ex.zh: 錯過她的生日讓我很內疚。

ex.en: Don't feel guilty about taking a day off.
ex.zh: 請一天假不用覺得內疚。

guilty.en: feeling bad because you did something wrong

ex.en: Will you tell me how to play the guitar?
ex.zh: 你可以教我彈吉他嗎？

ex.en: I want to learn how to play the guitar.
ex.zh: 我想學彈吉他。

ex.en: That guitar is so expensive that I can't buy it.
ex.zh: 那把吉他太貴了，我買不起。

guitar.en: a musical instrument with strings that you play with your fingers

guideline.zh: 指導方針、準則（常用複數）

ex.en: Please follow the safety guidelines.
ex.zh: 請遵守安全準則。

ex.en: The company issued new guidelines for remote work.
ex.zh: 公司發布了遠距工作的新規範。

ex.en: These guidelines will help you write a good report.
ex.zh: 這些準則能幫助你寫出好報告。

guideline.en: a rule or piece of advice about how to do something

ex.en: He doesn't have the guts to say no to my plan.
ex.zh: 他沒膽拒絕我的計畫。

ex.en: You've got a lot of guts.
ex.zh: 你膽子真大。

gut.en: the courage to do something difficult or frightening

ex.en: My gut tells me this deal is too good to be true.
ex.zh: 我的直覺告訴我這筆交易好得不像真的。

ex.en: I had a gut feeling that something was wrong.
ex.zh: 我直覺覺得有什麼不對勁。

gut.en: a strong feeling about something that does not come from facts

ex.en: He has a big beer gut.
ex.zh: 他有個大啤酒肚。

ex.en: Yogurt is good for your gut health.
ex.zh: 優格對腸道健康有益。

gut.en: the stomach and the tubes below it, or a fat belly

ex.en: I regard myself as your guardian.
ex.zh: 我把自己當成你的監護人。

ex.en: A parent or legal guardian must sign the consent form.
ex.zh: 家長或法定監護人必須在同意書上簽名。

guardian.en: a person who legally takes care of a child, or who protects something

ex.en: She had a vague feeling of guilt.
ex.zh: 她隱約地有一種的內疚感。

ex.en: His sense of guilt was diminished.
ex.zh: 他的內疚感減少了。

ex.en: She was filled with guilt after lying to her friend.
ex.zh: 她對朋友說謊後充滿了罪惡感。

guilt.en: the bad feeling you have when you have done something wrong

ex.en: I'm afraid he will never admit his guilt.
ex.zh: 恐怕他永遠也不會承認自己的罪行。

ex.en: He confessed his guilt.
ex.zh: 他承認他有罪。

ex.en: He admitted his guilt.
ex.zh: 他承認他有罪。

guilt.en: the fact that someone has done something against the law

ex.en: He should apologize for being rude to the guests.
ex.zh: 他應該為自己對客人無禮而道歉。

ex.en: I'm back! Oh? Have we got a guest?
ex.zh: 我回來了！咦？有客人啊？

ex.en: The motel can accommodate as many as 400 guests.
ex.zh: 這家汽車旅館最多可以接待 400 位房客。

guest.en: a person who is invited to a place or who pays to stay in a hotel

ex.en: I'll act as a guide for you.
ex.zh: 我來當你的導遊。

ex.en: They set out with a guide just in case they lost their way.
ex.zh: 他們請了一位嚮導同行，以免迷路。

ex.en: He acted as my guide.
ex.zh: 他擔任我的嚮導。

guide.en: a person who shows tourists around a place

ex.en: This book is a good guide for beginners.
ex.zh: 這本書是很好的入門指南。

ex.en: Check the travel guide for good restaurants.
ex.zh: 查查旅遊指南，找家好餐廳。

guide.en: a book that gives information or instructions about something

ex.en: The staff will guide you to your seats.
ex.zh: 工作人員會帶你們到座位。

ex.en: She guided us through the old town.
ex.zh: 她帶我們逛了老城區。

guide.en: to show someone the way by going with them

ex.en: We joined a guided tour of the old city.
ex.zh: 我們參加了老城區的導覽行程。

ex.en: Guided tours are available in English and Japanese.
ex.zh: 導覽行程提供英語和日語。

guided tour.en: a trip around a place led by a person who explains things

ex.en: Many ships cross the gulf every day.
ex.zh: 每天都有許多船隻穿越這個海灣。

ex.en: The town sits on the shore of a wide gulf.
ex.zh: 這座小鎮位於一個寬闊海灣的岸邊。

ex.en: There is a huge gulf between rich and poor.
ex.zh: 貧富之間存在著巨大的鴻溝。

ex.en: The argument created a gulf between the two friends.
ex.zh: 那場爭吵讓兩個朋友之間產生了隔閡。

ex.en: In the Middle Ages, a guild protected the interests of skilled craftsmen.
ex.zh: 中世紀時，行會保護技術工匠的利益。

ex.en: She joined a writers' guild to meet other authors.
ex.zh: 她加入作家協會，結識其他作者。

ex.en: Honesty is the guiding principle of our company.
ex.zh: 誠實是我們公司的指導原則。

ex.en: She was my guiding light when I was young.
ex.zh: 她是我年輕時的明燈。

ex.en: The guide is guiding the group through the old town.
ex.zh: 導遊正帶領這群人走過老城區。

ex.en: He's guiding his little sister across the busy road.
ex.zh: 他正牽著妹妹過馬路。

ex.en: The guitarist played a quiet song on stage.
ex.zh: 吉他手在台上彈了一首輕柔的歌。

ex.en: My brother wants to become a professional guitarist.
ex.zh: 我哥哥想成為職業吉他手。

ex.en: Police arrested the gunman near the station.
ex.zh: 警方在車站附近逮捕了持槍歹徒。

ex.en: Witnesses described the gunman to the officers.
ex.zh: 目擊者向警員描述了那名持槍歹徒。

ex.en: The company offers a guaranteed refund within thirty days.
ex.zh: 公司提供三十天內保證退款。

ex.en: Success is never guaranteed, but you should still try.
ex.zh: 成功從來沒有保證，但你還是該試試看。

ex.en: Leaves blocked the gutter and rain spilled over the roof.
ex.zh: 落葉堵住了雨水槽，雨水從屋頂溢出來。

ex.en: Cars splashed water from the gutter onto the sidewalk.
ex.zh: 車子把排水溝裡的水濺到人行道上。

ex.en: Guinea is a country on the west coast of Africa.
ex.zh: 幾內亞是位於非洲西岸的一個國家。

ex.en: Our teacher showed us where Guinea is on the map.
ex.zh: 老師在地圖上指給我們看幾內亞的位置。

ex.en: He is a well-known fitness guru with millions of fans.
ex.zh: 他是知名的健身大師，擁有數百萬粉絲。

ex.en: Ask our tech guru if your computer won't start.
ex.zh: 電腦開不了機的話，去問我們的技術大師。

ex.en: The young man traveled to India to study with a spiritual guru.
ex.zh: 那位年輕人前往印度，跟隨一位精神導師學習。

ex.en: Followers listened quietly as the guru spoke.
ex.zh: 信眾安靜地聆聽導師說話。

ex.en: We joined a guided tour of the old town.
ex.zh: 我們參加了老城區的導覽行程。

ex.en: The museum offers a guided walk every Saturday.
ex.zh: 博物館每週六都有導覽步行活動。

guided.zh: 引導、帶領（guide 的過去式）

ex.en: The guard guided us through the dark tunnel.
ex.zh: 警衛帶領我們穿過黑暗的隧道。

ex.en: Her teacher guided her through the difficult exercise.
ex.zh: 她的老師引導她完成這個困難的練習。

ex.en: He entered the building in the guise of a delivery man.
ex.zh: 他假扮成送貨員進入大樓。

ex.en: The scam came in the guise of a friendly email.
ex.zh: 這個詐騙以一封友善電子郵件的樣貌出現。

ex.en: The old idea returned in a new guise.
ex.zh: 舊想法換了新面貌再度出現。

ex.en: It takes guts to speak up in front of the whole class.
ex.zh: 要在全班面前發言需要勇氣。

ex.en: He didn't have the guts to tell her the truth.
ex.zh: 他沒有膽量告訴她實話。

ex.en: The cook removed the guts of the fish before frying it.
ex.zh: 廚師在煎魚之前先把魚的內臟取出。

ex.en: The vet explained that the dog's guts were not damaged.
ex.zh: 獸醫說明那隻狗的內臟沒有受損。

ex.en: Residents were woken by the sound of gunfire in the distance.
ex.zh: 居民被遠處的槍聲吵醒。

ex.en: The soldiers moved forward under heavy gunfire.
ex.zh: 士兵們在猛烈的火力下向前推進。

ex.en: We heard a gunshot in the distance.
ex.zh: 我們聽到遠處傳來一聲槍響。

ex.en: The loud gunshot made the birds fly away.
ex.zh: 那聲巨大的槍響讓鳥群飛散。

ex.en: The doctor treated the man for a gunshot wound.
ex.zh: 醫生為那名男子治療槍傷。

ex.en: Gunshot injuries need immediate medical care.
ex.zh: 槍傷需要立即就醫。

ex.en: A gull landed on the railing and stared at my sandwich.
ex.zh: 一隻海鷗停在欄杆上，盯著我的三明治。

ex.en: We watched the gulls circle above the fishing boats.
ex.zh: 我們看著海鷗在漁船上方盤旋。

ex.en: The salesman gulled the tourists into buying fake souvenirs.
ex.zh: 那個推銷員騙遊客買了假的紀念品。

ex.en: Don't let them gull you with promises of easy money.
ex.zh: 別讓他們用輕鬆賺錢的承諾騙了你。

ex.en: A sudden gust of wind blew my hat off.
ex.zh: 一陣突來的強風把我的帽子吹走了。

ex.en: Gusts of wind rattled the windows all night.
ex.zh: 整晚陣陣強風震得窗戶嘎嘎作響。

ex.en: Rainwater ran down the gully after the storm.
ex.zh: 暴雨過後，雨水沿著溝壑流下。

ex.en: The hikers climbed carefully out of the deep gully.
ex.zh: 登山客小心地爬出深深的溝壑。

ex.en: The gunner aimed at the target on the hill.
ex.zh: 炮手瞄準了山丘上的目標。

ex.en: The old film shows a gunner sitting in a tank.
ex.zh: 那部老電影裡有一名炮手坐在戰車裡。

ex.en: He gulped down a glass of water after the run.
ex.zh: 跑完步後他一口氣灌下一杯水。

ex.en: She gulped her coffee and ran out the door.
ex.zh: 她大口喝完咖啡就衝出門了。

ex.en: He drank the juice in one gulp.
ex.zh: 他一口氣喝完了果汁。

ex.en: With a nervous gulp, she opened the door.
ex.zh: 她緊張地吞了一口口水，打開了門。

ex.en: Water gushed from the broken pipe.
ex.zh: 水從破裂的水管裡噴湧而出。

ex.en: Tears gushed down her face when she heard the news.
ex.zh: 聽到消息時，她的淚水奪眶而出。

ex.en: A gush of cold air came through the door.
ex.zh: 一股冷空氣從門口灌了進來。

ex.en: There was a sudden gush of water from the tap.
ex.zh: 水龍頭突然湧出一大股水。

ex.en: We bought a guidebook before our trip to Kyoto.
ex.zh: 去京都旅行前，我們買了一本旅遊指南。

ex.en: The guidebook lists cheap hotels near the station.
ex.zh: 這本指南列出車站附近的平價旅館。

guildford.zh: 吉爾福德（英國薩里郡的城鎮）

ex.en: Guildford is a town in the county of Surrey in England.
ex.zh: 吉爾福德是英格蘭薩里郡的一座城鎮。

ex.en: Guildford is about forty kilometers southwest of London.
ex.zh: 吉爾福德位於倫敦西南方約四十公里處。

ex.en: Guatemala is a country in Central America.
ex.zh: 瓜地馬拉是中美洲的一個國家。

ex.en: Guatemala is known for its coffee and old Mayan ruins.
ex.zh: 瓜地馬拉以咖啡和古老的馬雅遺跡聞名。

ex.en: He gave a guarded answer to the reporter's question.
ex.zh: 他對記者的問題給了個保留的回答。

ex.en: She was guarded about her plans for the future.
ex.zh: 她對自己未來的計畫守口如瓶。

guarded.zh: 看守、保護（guard 的過去式）

ex.en: Two soldiers guarded the gate all night.
ex.zh: 兩名士兵整晚看守著大門。

ex.en: The dog guarded the house while we were away.
ex.zh: 我們不在家時，狗守護著房子。

ex.en: The gubernatorial election will be held next month.
ex.zh: 州長選舉將在下個月舉行。

ex.en: Both candidates took part in a gubernatorial debate on television.
ex.zh: 兩位候選人都參加了電視上的州長辯論。

ex.en: We bought Guatemalan coffee at the market.
ex.zh: 我們在市場買了瓜地馬拉咖啡。

ex.en: The Guatemalan village is known for its colorful textiles.
ex.zh: 那個瓜地馬拉村莊以色彩繽紛的織品聞名。

ex.en: My teacher is a Guatemalan who moved here years ago.
ex.zh: 我的老師是多年前搬來的瓜地馬拉人。

ex.en: Many Guatemalans celebrate holidays with big family meals.
ex.zh: 許多瓜地馬拉人在節日時會全家一起吃大餐。

ex.en: Nurses rolled the patient down the hall on a gurney.
ex.zh: 護理師用輪床把病人推過走廊。

ex.en: The paramedics lifted him onto the gurney.
ex.zh: 救護人員把他抬上輪床。

ex.en: I need a guarantor to sign the rental contract.
ex.zh: 我需要一位保證人在租約上簽名。

ex.en: Her father agreed to be the guarantor of her loan.
ex.zh: 她的父親同意擔任她貸款的保證人。

ex.en: Gunpowder was invented in ancient China.
ex.zh: 火藥是古代中國發明的。

ex.en: The museum has a small barrel of gunpowder from the old fort.
ex.zh: 博物館裡有一小桶來自舊堡壘的火藥。

gunpoint.zh: 槍口（at gunpoint：在槍口威脅下）

ex.en: The bank workers were held at gunpoint during the robbery.
ex.zh: 搶案發生時，銀行員工被槍指著控制住。

ex.en: He said he was forced to sign the paper at gunpoint.
ex.zh: 他說自己是在槍口威脅下被迫簽下那份文件的。

ex.en: The guillotine was widely used during the French Revolution.
ex.zh: 斷頭台在法國大革命期間被廣泛使用。

ex.en: The teacher cut the paper in a straight line with a guillotine.
ex.zh: 老師用裁紙刀把紙裁得筆直。

guillotine.zh: 用斷頭台處死；用裁刀切

ex.en: In 1793 the king was guillotined in Paris.
ex.zh: 1793年，國王在巴黎被送上斷頭台處決。

ex.en: She guillotined the stack of posters to the right size.
ex.zh: 她用裁紙機把那疊海報裁成合適的大小。

ex.en: The children ate the pizza with gusto.
ex.zh: 孩子們津津有味地吃著披薩。

ex.en: She sang the song with great gusto.
ex.zh: 她充滿熱情地唱著那首歌。

ex.en: We ate a big bowl of chicken and sausage gumbo.
ex.zh: 我們吃了一大碗雞肉香腸秋葵濃湯。

ex.en: The meeting turned into a gumbo of ideas.
ex.zh: 那場會議變成了各種想法的大雜燴。

ex.en: It was a gutsy move to quit her job and start a business.
ex.zh: 辭職創業是個很有膽量的決定。

ex.en: The team put on a gutsy performance.
ex.zh: 球隊展現了一場有魄力的表現。

ex.en: Finding the cause was mostly guesswork at first.
ex.zh: 一開始找出原因大多只能靠猜。

ex.en: Use a scale and take the guesswork out of baking.
ex.zh: 用秤來量，烘焙就不用再靠猜了。

ex.en: He is so gullible that he believes every advertisement.
ex.zh: 他太容易受騙，每個廣告都信。

ex.en: Scammers often target gullible people.
ex.zh: 詐騙集團常以輕信的人為目標。

ex.en: The water gurgled down the drain.
ex.zh: 水汩汩地流進排水孔。

ex.en: The baby gurgled happily in her crib.
ex.zh: 寶寶在嬰兒床裡開心地咕咕作聲。
